blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Robust demoiréing of screen-recaptured images remains challenging: moiré varies in frequency, color, and spatial support across display-camera pairs and capture conditions. Dedicated restoration networks trained on finite paired data struggle with this diversity, especially when low-frequency color banding and high-frequency stripes co-occur. We present DemoiréEdit, a content-preserving editing framework that adapts the natural-image prior of a pretrained flow-matching editor to demoiréing. First, an endpoint-supervised training objective supplements velocity matching with pixel, perceptual, and frequency-domain restoration losses. Second, a dual-scale condition-shift strategy performs global correction at low resolution, then refines the image at full resolution by shifting the denoising condition from the first-stage output to the original input for detail recovery. We also introduce DailyMoiré130, a benchmark of challenging moiré in everyday screen photography, comprising 130 smartphone captures across diverse displays with low-frequency color banding, fine high-frequency stripes, and mixed-frequency interference. On the challenging DailyMoiré130 benchmark, our method achieves the lowest residual moiré area and receives 71.3% overall-quality preference in a blind Best-of-7 study with 31 participants. We also evaluate on paired FHDMi/UHDM, reducing residual moiré confidence by 47.1%/9.3% and increasing MUSIQ by 4.3%/2.0% over the best baseline for each metric.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Moiré artifacts arise from the spatial-frequency interference between a display’s pixel array and a camera’s sensor grid during screen recapture ( Sidorov & Kokaram, 2002 ; Sun et al., 2018 ; Wang et al., 2023a ) . Unlike noise or blur with a statistically stable spectrum, moiré has no fixed frequency signature: low-frequency color banding and high-frequency stripes can co-occur within the same image (Figs. 1 and 2 ). Their mixture varies with viewing angle, device pairing, and local scene content ( Sun et al., 2018 ; Yuan et al., 2019 ) , making the degradation difficult to characterize with a single spectral model.
blocks.zh: Moiré文物源于屏幕回收过程中显示的像素阵列和相机传感器网格之间的空间频率干扰(Sidorov & Kokaram,2002年;Sun等人,2018年;Wang等人,2023年a). 与噪音或带有统计稳定谱系的模糊性不同,moiré没有固定的频率信号:低频色带和高频条纹可以在同一图像(图1和图2)内共同粘合. 其混合物因取景角度,设备配对,以及局部场景内容而异(Sun等人,2018年;Yuan等人,2019年),使得降解过程难以用单一光谱模型进行定性.

blocks.en: Existing approaches train dedicated convolutional or transformer networks from scratch on dataset-specific moiré pairs ( Sun et al., 2018 ; He et al., 2019 ; Zheng et al., 2020 ; Liu et al., 2020 ; He et al., 2020 ; Yu et al., 2022 ; Xiao et al., 2024 ; Zhong et al., 2024 ; Liu et al., 2025 ) . These models lack a broader natural-image prior, and their restoration quality can degrade on scenes, devices, or capture conditions outside the training distribution. Moreover, existing benchmarks cover relatively limited device pairings and capture conditions ( Sun et al., 2018 ; Yuan et al., 2019 ; Yuan et al., 2020 ; He et al., 2020 ; Yu et al., 2022 ; Xu et al., 2024 ) . This limited diversity underrepresents complex real-world moiré, limiting how accurately these benchmarks assess demoiréing performance in the wild.
blocks.zh: 现有方法从零开始在数据集特有的moiré配对上训练专用转录或变压器网络(Sun等人,2018年;He等人,2019年;Zheng等人,2020年;Liu等人,2018年). 2020;He等人,2020;Yu等人,2022;Xiao等人,2024;Zhong等人,2024;Liu等人,2025). 这些模型在前期缺乏更广泛的自然形象,它们的修复质量可以在场景,设备上降解,或者捕捉训练分发以外的条件. 此外,现有基准涵盖相对有限的设备配对和捕获条件(Sun等人,2018年;Yuan等人,2019年;Yuan等人,2020年;He等人,2020年;Yu等人,2022年;Xu等人,2024年)。 这种有限的多样性掩盖了复杂的现实世界的模样,限制了这些基准如何准确评估野外的降级表现。

blocks.en: Our key observation is that dedicated demoiréing models trained on limited paired data often struggle to restore complex real-world textures under challenging out-of-distribution moiré corruption. Their ability to recover the underlying content is constrained by the visual patterns represented in their training data. In contrast, a pretrained image editor provides a broader natural-image prior acquired through large-scale pretraining, offering the potential to restore content under severe moiré corruption beyond the coverage of task-specific paired data ( Rombach et al., 2022 ; Brooks et al., 2023 ; Saharia et al., 2022 ; Zhang et al., 2023 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Lin et al., 2024 ; Yu et al., 2024 ) . This motivates treating demoiréing as a content-preserving editing task and adapting a pretrained flow-matching image editor ( Wu et al., 2025 ) to exploit this prior.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要观察是,经过有限配对数据培训的专用降级模型往往在挑战分配外的腐败的情况下努力恢复复杂的现实世界纹理。 他们恢复基本内容的能力受到其培训数据所体现的视觉模式的限制。 相比之下,经过预先训练的图像编辑器提供了通过大规模预先训练获得的更广泛的自然图像,提供了在严重摩尔腐败下恢复内容的潜力,超出了特定任务配对数据的涵盖范围(Rombach等人,2022年;Brooks等人,2023年;Saharia等人,2022年;张等人,2023年;Wang等人,2024年;Lin等人,2024年;Yu等人,2024年)。 这促使人们将降级视为一种保存内容的编辑任务,并改编一个经过预先训练的流量匹配图像编辑器(Wu等人,2025年)来利用这个前作.

blocks.en: However, applying this generative prior to demoiréing requires adapting it to the fidelity demands of image restoration. We therefore supplement standard velocity matching with endpoint restoration losses that directly supervise the restored image. The remaining challenge is to handle the co-occurrence of low-frequency color banding and high-frequency stripes while preserving fine details. To address this, DemoiréEdit uses a dual-scale condition-shift strategy that first performs global correction at low resolution and then refines the image at full resolution. Since the corrected estimate provides global guidance but lacks fine detail, early denoising steps use the Stage 1 output, whereas later steps return to the original input for detail recovery.
blocks.zh: 然而,在降级前应用这种基因需要适应图像恢复的忠诚要求. 因此,我们补充了标准速度与端点恢复损失的匹配,直接监督恢复的图像。 剩下的挑战是处理低频带色和高频条纹的共同发生,同时保留细微的细节. 为了解决这个问题,DemoiréEdit采用了双比例条件转换策略,首先以低分辨率进行全球校正,然后以全分辨率改进图像. 由于经更正的估计数提供了全球指导,但缺乏细微细节,早期的去名步骤使用第一阶段的产出,而后来的步骤则恢复到原始投入中进行详细回收。

blocks.en: To evaluate challenging moiré encountered in daily life, we introduce DailyMoiré130 : 130 smartphone captures of signage, monitors, and laptops exhibiting low-frequency color banding, fine high-frequency stripes, and mixed-frequency interference (Fig. 4 ). These captures lack aligned clean targets; evaluation combines residual moiré metrics with separate human judgments of suppression, detail preservation, and overall quality.
blocks.zh: 为了评估日常生活中遇到的挑战性摩尔语,我们介绍了DailyMoiré130:130个智能手机捕获显示低频色幅、细高频条纹和混合频干扰的信号、显示器和笔记本电脑(图4)。 这些捕捉结果缺乏一致的清洁目标;评价将残留的moiré指标与人类对压制、细节保存和总体质量的单独判断结合起来。

blocks.en: On DailyMoiré130, our method achieves the lowest residual moiré area and receives 71.3% overall-quality preference in a blind Best-of-7 study with 31 participants. We also evaluate on paired FHDMi/UHDM, reducing residual moiré confidence by 47.1%/9.3% and increasing MUSIQ by 4.3%/2.0% over the best baseline for each metric (Tab. 2 ). Our contributions are: • We reformulate demoiréing as content-preserving editing and introduce endpoint-supervised flow training to adapt a pretrained editor for faithful restoration. • We propose dual-scale condition-shift inference to separate global moiré correction from full-resolution detail recovery. • We introduce DailyMoiré130 , a benchmark targeting challenging moiré in everyday screen photography, with a reference-free evaluation protocol. The dataset is publicly available to support future comparisons (Appendix D ).

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Early demoiréing methods relied on hand-crafted spectral priors or signal-processing
assumptions to suppress periodic moiré patterns ( Sidorov & Kokaram, 2002 ; Siddiqui et al., 2009 ; Liu et al., 2015 ) . With the rise of deep learning, Sun et al. ( Sun et al., 2018 ) introduced the first
CNN-based solution, followed by frequency-aware designs using learnable bandpass
filters ( Zheng et al., 2020 ) , wavelet decomposition ( Liu et al., 2020 ; Luo et al., 2020 ; Yeh et al., 2024 ) , and multiscale fusion ( Peng et al., 2024 ) .
Subsequent work extends demoiréing to ultra-high-definition inputs ( Yu et al., 2022 ; Xiao et al., 2024 ) , unpaired data ( Zhong et al., 2024 ) , RAW-domain processing ( Xu et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2025a ) ,
and universal data generation ( Yang et al., 2025b ; Choi, 2018 ) . In particular,
Freqformer ( Liu et al., 2025 ) explicitly separates moiré artifacts into high-frequency
localized textures and low-frequency color distortions. While these approaches emphasize task-specific frequency modeling, we adapt a pretrained editor’s natural-image prior to challenging real-world moiré.

blocks.en: Our model builds on Qwen-Edit ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , a flow-matching image editor conditioned on a source image, edit references, and a text prompt. We first define the restoration objective and training procedure, then describe dual-scale inference (Fig. 3 ) and the training data.

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We fine-tune the pretrained Qwen-Edit ( Wu et al., 2025 ) flow-matching editor via LoRA ( Hu et al., 2022 ) adapters on DiT using our endpoint-supervised objective (Sec. 3.2 ) on the mixed datasets described in Sec. 3.4 , which aggregates six public demoiréing datasets. We use a batch size of 96 and a patch size of 256 × 256 256\times 256 with a cosine learning-rate schedule decaying from 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} to 1 × 10 − 7 1\times 10^{-7} . We fine-tune for 3k optimizer steps. All experiments are conducted on 4 NVIDIA H100 GPUs. During inference, Stage 1 resizes the input to a short side of 1024 pixels and uses 10 denoising steps. Stage 2 starts from latent noise at full resolution and uses N = 10 N{=}10 steps with switching ratio r = 0.3 r{=}0.3 . The fixed prompt and full training recipe are given in Appendix C .

blocks.en: To assess restoration in challenging everyday screen-capture scenarios, we collect DailyMoiré130 , a benchmark of 130 screen photographs from shopping-mall signage, desktop monitors, and laptops. These captures exhibit low-frequency color banding, fine high-frequency stripes, and mixed-frequency interference, and have no aligned clean targets. They were captured with iPhone 17, vivo X200s, Honor 90 Pro, Huawei Enjoy 90 Pro Max, and iPhone 16 Pro Max (Fig. 4 ). We also use FHDMi ( He et al., 2020 ) with 2019 1080p images and UHDM ( Yu et al., 2022 ) with 500 4K images for paired evaluation. Due to the spatially non-uniform nature of moiré, full-image fidelity metrics such as PSNR and SSIM ( Wang et al., 2004 ) can be dominated by artifact-free regions and fail to reflect actual moiré removal quality.
blocks.zh: 为了评估在挑战性日常屏幕捕捉情景中的恢复情况,我们收集了DailyMoiré130,这是从购物-马列标志、桌面显示器和膝上型计算机上130张屏幕照片的基准。 这些捕捉物呈现出低频色带,细细的高频条纹,以及混合频率干扰,没有对齐的干净目标. 他们与iPhone 17,vivo X200s,Honor 90 Pro,Huawei Enjoy 90 Pro Max,以及iPhone 16 Pro Max(图4)一起被俘. 我们还使用FHDMi(He et al.,2020年)的2019 1080p图像和UHDM(Yu et al.,2022年)的500 4K图像进行配对评价. 由于moiré的空间非统一性质,PSNR和SSIM(王等人,2004年)等全图像忠诚度度量衡可以以无文物区域为主,不能反映实际的moiré清除质量.

blocks.en: We therefore additionally report two auxiliary metrics based on a pretrained moiré detector 𝒟 \mathcal{D} ( Yang et al., 2023 ) called MoiréDet. Given a restored image I ^ \hat{I} , we divide it into P P overlapping patches and obtain a moiré probability c i ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] c_{i}\in[0,1] for each patch, where a higher c i c_{i} indicates stronger moiré presence. Let M M denote the number of patches whose moiré probability exceeds 0.05 0.05 . We define: RMC = 1 P ​ ∑ i = 1 P c i , RMA = M P . \mathrm{RMC}=\frac{1}{P}\sum_{i=1}^{P}c_{i},\qquad\mathrm{RMA}=\frac{M}{P}. (11) RMC measures the average moiré confidence across all patches, and RMA captures the proportion of patches with detectable residual artifacts. We also report four no-reference image quality metrics: MUSIQ ( Ke et al., 2021 ) , MANIQA ( Yang et al., 2022 ) , CLIP-IQA+ ( Wang et al., 2023b ) , and TOPIQ ( Chen et al., 2024 ) for paired datasets and CLIP-IQA+ for DailyMoiré130, which assess perceptual quality without requiring ground-truth references.

We compare with ESDNet-L ( Yu et al., 2022 ) , a dedicated demoiréing network, along with three general-purpose image restoration methods: MoCE-IR ( Zamfir et al., 2025 ) , AdaIR ( Cui et al., 2025 ) , and the diffusion-based OSEDiff ( Wu et al., 2024a ) .
These four baselines are retrained on the same mixed training data for 50k optimizer
updates, using their official training configurations.
We additionally compare with MZNet ( Lee et al., 2025 ) , trained on the same mixed data for 50k updates, and a UniDemoiré-style augmentation control ( Yang et al., 2025b ) , obtained by fine-tuning ESDNet-L for 10k updates with real paired and synthetic data. Freqformer code and weights were unavailable during these experiments.

blocks.en: 4.2 Quantitative Evaluation
blocks.zh: 4.2 定量评价

blocks.en: Tab. 1 evaluates all methods on our proposed DailyMoiré130, which targets challenging moiré in everyday screen photography. In a blind Best-of-7 study with 31 participants, our method is preferred in 74.7% of trials for moiré suppression, 68.5% for detail preservation, and 71.3% for overall quality. Participants assess detail preservation separately against the visible input using full-image views and magnified crops (Appendix E ). The strongest baseline, ESDNet-L, receives 8.8% overall preference. The no-reference perceptual metric further supports this finding, with our method achieving the highest CLIP-IQA+ (0.5928). It also achieves the lowest residual moiré area (0.0551), while UniDemoiré-control has slightly lower RMC. These results demonstrate effective moiré suppression and strong human preference on challenging real-world captures.
blocks.zh: Tab. 1 评估了我们拟议的《Moiré130日报》的所有方法。 在一项有31人参加的盲目最佳-7研究中,我们的方法在74.7%的模拟抑制试验、68.5%的细节保存试验和71.3%的整体质量试验中得到偏好。 与会者利用全图像视图和放大作物(附录E),对可见输入进行详细保存评估。 最强基线ESDNet-L获得8.8%的总偏好. 无参考感知度量进一步支持了这一结论,我们的方法实现了最高的CLIP-IQA+(0.5928). 它还实现了最低残留的moiré区(0.0551),而UniDemoiré-control则略有较低的RMC. 这些结果表明,人类对挑战现实世界的捕捉工作抱有强烈的倾向和强烈的抑制作用。

blocks.en: Each participant completes 18 Best-of-7 trials, collectively covering all 130 images, with method identities hidden and candidate positions randomized and counterbalanced. Uncertain responses remain in the denominator. The overall-quality preference rate has a participant-clustered 95% confidence interval of 65.1–76.9%, and the result remains consistent under stricter attention checks (Appendix E ).
blocks.zh: 每个参与者完成18次最佳7次试验,集体覆盖所有130个图像,方法身份隐蔽,候选人职位随机和平衡。 不确定的反应仍然在分母中。 整体质量优惠率的参与者集群95%的置信间隔为65.1-76.9%,结果在更严格的关注检查下保持不变(附录E)。

blocks.en: Our method reduces RMC by 47.1% and 9.3%, respectively, relative to the strongest baseline for this metric, and improves MUSIQ by 4.3% and 2.0%. While regression-based methods achieve higher PSNR, they retain more residual moiré, indicating a trade-off between pixel fidelity and artifact removal. Appendix G reports SSIM, LPIPS, and MANIQA for all methods.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法将RMC分别比这一度量的最强基线减少47.1%和9.3%,并将MUSIQ改善4.3%和2.0%. 虽然基于回归的方法可以实现更高的PSNR,但它们保留了更多的残留moiré,表明像素忠诚度和文物清除之间的权衡. 附录G报告SSIM、LPIPS和MANIQA的所有方法。

blocks.en: Moreover, we assess content fidelity against clean references on UHDM to complement the dedicated human detail assessment on DailyMoiré130. Our method achieves the highest TOPIQ-FR of 0.670, compared with 0.664 for the strongest baseline, MZNet. It also obtains the second-best PieAPP of 0.984 and AHIQ of 0.435 among the compared methods, while its chroma and hue errors remain comparable to those of feed-forward restorers (Appendix G , Tab. 11 ). Unlike TOPIQ in Tab. 2 , TOPIQ-FR uses the clean reference. These results provide complementary evidence of content preservation alongside the gains in moiré suppression.
blocks.zh: 此外,我们参照关于UHDM的干净参考,评估内容是否忠实,以补充《Moiré 130日报》的人类细节评估。 我们的方法实现了最高的TOPIQ-FR为0.670,而最强基线MZNet则为0.664. 它还在比较方法中获得了0.984和0.435的AHIQ的第二佳PieAPP,而其染色体和色调错误仍然与向导恢复器(Appendix G, Tab. 11 )相当. 与Tab 2中的TOPIQ不同,TOPIQ-FR使用干净的引用. 这些结果提供了补充证据,说明内容保存情况与抑制 " 摩伊雷 " 的收益同时存在。

blocks.en: Fig. 5 shows qualitative comparisons on paired benchmarks. Several baselines leave visible residual moiré on the toy’s face. In contrast, our method suppresses these artifacts while retaining visible wood grain and fur around the face. Fig. 6 further demonstrates generalization to challenging everyday captures in DailyMoiré130. The from-scratch baselines shown leave visible artifacts in these out-of-distribution real-world cases. In contrast, our method uses the pretrained editor prior to produce cleaner results, particularly where high-frequency stripes and low-frequency color banding occur within the same image. The DailyMoiré130 examples also show faithful text reproduction.

Keeping the Stage 1 condition throughout Stage 2 ( r = 1 r=1 ) slightly improves PSNR but degrades perceptual quality and moiré suppression. Black image conditioning trades marginal RMC/RMA for better LPIPS, SSIM, and MUSIQ. Fig. 7 illustrates these effects on DailyMoiré130.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: Our method improves visible moiré suppression through a pretrained natural-image prior, but introduces trade-offs. Restored images may not align exactly with clean targets, lowering PSNR/SSIM, and severe color bands can retain color shifts. Two-stage inference is costly and not optimized for real-time use. We therefore assess fidelity, perceptual quality, and residual moiré jointly.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法通过预先训练的自然形象改进了可见的摩尔抑制,但引入了权衡. 恢复的图像可能不能完全与干净的目标对齐,降低PSNR/SSIM,重彩带可以保留色调. 两阶段推论成本高昂,不优化实时使用. 因此,我们共同评估忠诚、感知质量和剩余货币。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We present a content-preserving editing framework for real-world demoiréing. Endpoint supervision adapts a pretrained natural-image prior to restoration, while dual-scale condition-shift inference combines global correction with detail recovery. Moreover, we introduce DailyMoiré130 to evaluate challenging everyday screen photographs with color bands, fine stripes, and mixed-frequency artifacts. Our method achieves the lowest residual moiré area and strong human preference on this benchmark, with complementary gains on paired datasets. These results support pretrained editing priors for restoring moiré-corrupted content beyond the coverage of task-specific paired data.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个内容保留编辑框架,用于现实世界的降级。 端点监督在恢复前会调整预先训练的自然图像,而双尺度条件变化推论则将全球校正与细节恢复相结合. 此外,我们推出DailyMoiré130, 以彩色带、细条纹和混合频率文物来评价挑战性的每日屏幕照片。 我们的方法实现了最低的剩余摩尔面积,人类对这一基准的强烈偏好,在对联数据集上取得了互补的收益。 这些结果支持预先经过培训的编辑前科,以恢复超出特定任务配对数据的覆盖范围的内容。

blocks.en: Appendix D DailyMoiré130 Dataset and Evaluation Protocol DailyMoiré130 contains 130 real-world screen photographs targeting challenging moiré in everyday life. The images cover signage, monitors, and laptops, with low-frequency color banding, fine high-frequency stripes, and mixed-frequency interference. Since these captures have no aligned clean targets, evaluation combines no-reference perceptual scores, residual moiré detector scores, and human preference (Tab. 1 ). Public release. DailyMoiré130 is available on Hugging Face (revision 573da28 ), with per-image checksums and an evaluation protocol. The public release retains the original resolutions and color profiles. It includes local blur in 18 images, while the remaining 112 retain their scene pixels; pixels outside the edited regions are unchanged. The localized edits are partial occlusion rather than comprehensive anonymization. Such edits can affect restoration outputs and no-reference metrics. The results reported in this manuscript use the historical inputs and have not been rerun on this public derivative. For detector-based analysis, a restored image is divided into P P overlapping patches with moiré confidence c i ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] c_{i}\in[0,1] . RMC averages these confidence scores, while RMA measures the fraction of patches exceeding 0.05, as defined in Eq. 11 .

The localized edits are partial occlusion rather than comprehensive anonymization. Such edits can affect restoration outputs and no-reference metrics. The results reported in this manuscript use the historical inputs and have not been rerun on this public derivative.
blocks.zh: DailyMoiré130可在Hugging Face(修订版573da28)上获得,并附有每个图像的校验和以及一个评价协议. 公开发布保留了原始分辨率和色彩描述. 它包括了18幅图像中的局部模糊,其余的112幅保留了场景像素;编辑区域外的像素不变. 本地化的编辑是部分隐含,而不是全面的无名化. 此类编辑可影响恢复产出和无参考指标。 本手稿中报道的结果使用了历史投入,没有再对这个公共衍生物进行重播.

blocks.en: For detector-based analysis, a restored image is divided into P P overlapping patches with moiré confidence c i ∈ [ 0 , 1 ] c_{i}\in[0,1] . RMC averages these confidence scores, while RMA measures the fraction of patches exceeding 0.05, as defined in Eq. 11 .
blocks.zh: 对于基于探测器的分析,一个恢复的图像被分为PP重叠补丁与moiré置信c i ∈ [0, 1] c_{i}\in [0,1]. RMC平均这些置信分数,而RMA测量的补丁分数超过0.05,在Eq. 11中定义.

blocks.en: Appendix E Human Preference Study
blocks.zh: 附录E 人类优先研究

blocks.en: The blind study includes 31 participants who complete the randomized questionnaire and pass at least one of two embedded attention checks. Each questionnaire contains 18 Best-of-7 trials, two black-reference A/B trials, and two attention checks. Each attention check presents one intact restoration alongside six strongly corrupted variants. Among the 31 completed questionnaires, 29 participants pass both checks and two pass one. We also report the stricter 29-participant subset below. Incomplete questionnaires and responses from the earlier, non-randomized questionnaire version are excluded.
blocks.zh: 盲目研究包括31名参与者,他们完成随机化的问卷调查,并至少通过两次嵌入式注意力检查中的一次. 每份调查表包含18项最佳7项审判、2项黑调A/B审判和2项注意检查。 每一个注意检查都有一个完整的修复 与六个严重腐烂的变体。 在31份填写完毕的调查问卷中,29名参与者通过检查,2名通过1份。 我们还报告下面更严格的29个参与者子集。 未完成的调查表和早先非随机调查表版本的答复不包括在内。

blocks.en: The study is conducted remotely on 13 laptops, 10 mobile devices, and eight desktops. A break is offered after Question 11. Summed active response time has a median of 10.5 minutes and an interquartile range of 6.9–13.8 minutes. Displays are not calibrated, and no formal visual-acuity or color-vision examination is imposed.
blocks.zh: 这项研究用13台膝上型计算机、10台移动设备和8台台式计算机远程进行。 问题11之后提供休息时间。 累计有效反应时间中位数为10.5分钟,方位间距为6.9–13.8分钟. 显示不校准,也不强制进行正式的视觉加速或色彩视觉检查.

blocks.en: The schedule contains 40 counterbalanced templates of 18 distinct main-trial images, assigning each image five or six times. Public entry cycles through these templates. The completed cohort uses 24 distinct templates, with seven repeated assignments. Its 558 main trials cover all 130 DailyMoiré130 images, with a median of four evaluations per image and a range of one to nine.
blocks.zh: 该时间表载有40个相互平衡的模板,包含18个不同的主审图像,分配每个图像5或6次。 通过这些模板公开进入周期。 完成的组群使用24个不同的模板,有7个重复的任务. 其558个主要试验覆盖了全部130个DailyMoiré130图像,每个图像的中位数为4个评价,范围为1到9个.

blocks.en: Each trial compares the seven methods in Tab. 1 , with identities hidden and randomized/counterbalanced across fixed A–G positions. Each method appears at each position 63–95 times. Participants inspect the input and candidates through full-image views and manually selected magnified crops. The same crop coordinates are used for every method and marked on the input overview.
blocks.zh: 每一次试验都比较Tab. 1中的7种方法,在固定的A-G位置上隐藏身份和随机/对称平衡。 每种方法出现在每个位置63-95次. 与会者通过全图像视图检查投入和候选人,并人工选择放大作物。 每种方法都使用相同的作物坐标,并在输入概览上标注。

blocks.en: For each image, participants answer three questions, translated here from the Chinese questionnaire. • Moiré suppression. Which result has fewer residual moiré patterns, color bands, and screen-photography artifacts? • Detail preservation. Which result better preserves the text, edges, colors, and content details in the input, without obvious rewriting, missing content, or structural deformation? • Overall quality. Overall, which result has better and more natural visual quality? Each question offers A–G, difficult to distinguish / no clear best , and unable to answer / image display problem . The detail question explicitly assesses preservation against the visible input.
blocks.zh: 对于每个图像,参与者回答三个问题,这里翻译自中文调查表. • 穆雷镇压。 哪一种结果能减少残留的摩尔图案、彩色带和屏幕摄影文物? • 详细保存。 哪些结果能更好地保存输入中的文字、边缘、颜色和内容细节,而不明显重写、缺少内容或结构变形? • 总体质量。 总体而言,哪些结果具有更好和更自然的视觉质量? 每个问题都提供A–G,难以区分/没有清晰的最好,无法回答/图像显示问题. 细节问题明确评估了相对于可见投入的保全。

blocks.en: Moiré suppression. Which result has fewer residual moiré patterns, color bands, and screen-photography artifacts?
blocks.zh: 莫伊雷镇压. 哪一种结果能减少残留的摩尔图案、彩色带和屏幕摄影文物?

blocks.en: Detail preservation. Which result better preserves the text, edges, colors, and content details in the input, without obvious rewriting, missing content, or structural deformation?
blocks.zh: 详细保存. 哪些结果能更好地保存输入中的文字、边缘、颜色和内容细节,而不明显重写、缺少内容或结构变形?

blocks.en: Overall quality. Overall, which result has better and more natural visual quality?
blocks.zh: 总体质量. 总体而言,哪些结果具有更好和更自然的视觉质量?

blocks.en: Tab. 8 reports all 558 responses per criterion, including uncertain choices. These account for 3.0%, 5.0%, and 3.9% of moiré, detail, and overall judgments. No main-trial response reports a display problem. A/B and attention trials are excluded.
blocks.zh: 附表8按标准报告所有558份答复,包括不确定的选择。 这些数额占政府、细节和总体判断的3.0%、5.0%和3.9%。 没有主审答复报告显示有问题。 A/B和注意力审判不包括在内。

blocks.zh: 表8:最佳7人选择数计入每日摩伊雷130。 每栏载有558项答复,包括不确定的答复。 百分比在Tab中报告。 1 (英语).

blocks.en: We use 20,000 bootstrap resamples and percentile 95% confidence intervals. The primary analysis samples 31 participants with replacement, retaining all their trials. An image-level sensitivity analysis separately samples 130 images with replacement, retaining all their responses. Each resample divides pooled selections by pooled trials, including uncertain responses. These are separate one-way cluster analyses. Tab. 9 reports both intervals for our method and ESDNet-L, the most-preferred baseline on all three criteria.
blocks.zh: 我们使用两万只靴子 和百分之九十五的置信间隔。 初级分析对31名参与者进行了更换抽样,保留了所有试验。 图像级敏感度分析将130幅图像分别取样并进行替换,保留其所有反应. 每一个再现都通过集合审判将集合选择区分开来,包括不确定的反应. 这些是单独的单向集群分析。 标签9报告了我们方法的间隔,以及ESDNet-L,这是所有三个标准中最首选的基准。

blocks.en: Table 9: Best-of-7 selection rates and separate cluster-bootstrap 95% confidence intervals (%). Participant clustering is the primary analysis, and image clustering is a sensitivity analysis.
blocks.zh: 表9:7项中的最佳选择率和单独的集群-波斯特区95%的置信间隔(%)。 参与者集群是主要分析,图像集群是敏感分析.

blocks.en: Requiring both checks retains 29 participants and 522 trials per criterion. Our method receives 74.3% moiré, 69.9% detail, and 73.2% overall preference, compared with 9.0%, 8.4%, and 8.0% for ESDNet-L. The preference advantage persists under this stricter rule.
blocks.zh: 要求两次检查都保留29名参与者和每个标准522次审判。 我们的方法获得74.3%的莫伊雷、69.9%的详情和73.2%的总体偏好,而ESDNet-L的偏好率为9.0%、8.4%和8.0%。 根据这一更严格的规则,优惠优势依然存在。

blocks.en: Our method receives the unique highest overall-quality vote count for 30 of 31 participants. The three criteria select the same outcome in 479/558 trials (85.8%), so they are not independent replications. The study supports perceived detail preservation under remote viewing, while unpaired images do not establish exact recovery of details hidden by corruption.
blocks.zh: 我们的方法得到31名参加者中30人独特的最高总质量选票数。 三项标准在479/558审判中选择了同样的结果(85.8%),因此它们不是独立的复制品. 该研究支持在远程观看下对细节进行感知保存,而未经描述的图像并不能确定对腐败所隐藏的细节的准确回收。

blocks.en: Appendix F Native Qwen-Edit Negative Control We also test native Qwen-Image-Edit-2509 without demoiré-specific LoRA training. Zero-shot attempts with the same prompt can turn structured moiré into large color blocks instead of preserving source content. This control separates the pretrained editing prior from task adaptation; it does not by itself establish the individual necessity of every loss or inference component. Figure 10: Native Qwen-Image-Edit-2509 negative control. The illustrated zero-shot outputs have large color-block artifacts and altered structure.
blocks.zh: 附录F 原生 Quen- Edit 负控 我们还测试本地的Quen-Image-Edit-2509,而不进行特制的LORA训练. 使用同样速率的零镜头尝试可以将结构化的moiré变成大的颜色块,而不是保存源内容. 这种控制将事先经过训练的编辑与任务调整区分开来;它本身并不确定每个损失或推论部分的个人必要性。 图10:土著Quen-Image-Edit-2509负控. 插图的零镜头输出有大型的彩色块文物和改变的结构.

blocks.en: Appendix G Additional paired-benchmark metrics
blocks.zh: 附录G 附加对等基准衡量标准

blocks.en: Tab. 10 completes the paired comparison in Tab. 2 . Our method achieves the highest MANIQA on both datasets. MZNet achieves the lowest LPIPS on both datasets and the highest SSIM on FHDMi, while MoCE-IR achieves the highest SSIM on UHDM. Together with PSNR in the main table, these results characterize the trade-off between full-reference fidelity and residual moiré suppression.
blocks.zh: Tab. 10在Tab中完成配对比较. 2,我们的方法在两个数据集上实现了最高的MANIQA. MZNet在两个数据集上实现了最低的LPIPS,在FHDMI上实现了最高的SSIM,而MOCE-IR在UHDM上实现了最高的SSIM. 这些结果与主要表格中的PSNR一起,是充分参照忠诚与剩余摩尔抑制之间的权衡。

blocks.en: Table 10: Additional metrics on FHDMi and UHDM. Best in bold , second-best underlined . Uni-control denotes UniDemoiré-style augmentation of ESDNet-L.
blocks.zh: 表10:关于FHDMI和UHDM的附加计量标准。 最佳的粗体,第二高下划线。 Uni-control表示UniDemoiré风格的ESDNet-L增强.

blocks.en: We further evaluate content fidelity against the clean references on UHDM using TOPIQ-FR ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , PieAPP ( Prashnani et al., 2018 ) , and AHIQ ( Lao et al., 2022 ) , together with CIE chroma and hue differences ( Sharma et al., 2005 ) . TOPIQ-FR uses the clean reference, whereas TOPIQ in Tab. 2 is the no-reference variant. Tab. 11 shows that our method achieves the highest TOPIQ-FR and the second-best PieAPP and AHIQ among the compared methods. Its chroma and hue errors are comparable to those of the feed-forward restorers, with MZNet achieving the lowest errors. These paired measurements complement the dedicated human detail assessment on DailyMoiré130, although neither establishes exact recovery of details that are unobservable in the corrupted input.
blocks.zh: 我们利用TOPIQ-FR(Chen等人,2024年),PieAPP(Prashnani等人,2018年),AHIQ(Lao等人,2022年),以及CIE 铬和Hue difference(Sharma等人,2005年),进一步对照UHIDM上的干净参考值来评价内容的忠实性。 TOPIQ-FR使用干净的参考,而TOPIQ则使用Tab. 2是无参考的变体. Tab.11显示,我们的方法在比较方法中达到了最高的TOPIQ-FR和第二的PieAPP和AHIQ. 它的染色体和湿度差错与向导恢复器的差错相当,MZNet实现最小差错. 这些配对测量补充了DailyMoiré130上的人类详细情况专门评估,尽管两者都无法准确恢复在腐败输入中无法观察到的细节。

blocks.en: Table 11: Content and color fidelity on UHDM. TOPIQ-FR is full-reference, whereas TOPIQ in Tab. 2 is no-reference. Best values are bold. Uni-control denotes UniDemoiré-style augmentation of ESDNet-L.
